attBesluta.text: VERY HAPPY WITH MY PURCHASE, GOOD & STRONG, THE WHEELS ROLL GREAT & LOCK WHEN REQUIRED, GREAT ITEM & ASSETT IN MY GARAGE.

Just finished putting this together. Instructions were just OK... photos are WAY too small, otherwise ok. Packaging was excellent with all metal parts even bubblerwrapped. The steel components are very well painted and seem very sturdy. The "tires" on the four wheels are not plastic but a "rubbery" material that has some give - thus, the unit rolls smoothly and quietly - very nice movement! Improvements: 1) Better photos in the instructions and 2) plastic or rubber caps to go over the threads of the bolt that serves as an axle for the non-swivelling wheels as they stick out right at ankle level and 3) have a thicker plate for the adjustable floor pads to thread through (the tab on mine has at most 2 threads of engagement that hold all the weight on one end (or maybe weld a nut onto that tab to get more like 5 - 6 threads engaged)) Overall a very solid unit and feels like very high quallity when assembled. Would buy again. (and to help with the minimal thread engagement on the adjutable "feet" you could put the provided locking nut BELOW the table rather than above the tab as show in the instructions)

Hyvä ja tukeva ruuvipenkki. Tarkasti koneistettu. Ainoa mitä ihmettelen ovat mukana tulleet "kiinnityspalikat". Eivät sovi vakio T-uraan eivätkä mukana tulleet ruuvit olisi siihen riittäneetkään. Palikat ovat onneksi sopivan korkuisia, että sopivat vestiraudan toiseen päähän. Muuta käyttöä en niille keksinyt.
